profiles.trustBoundary: Local file results can guide route planning, but only declared evidence artifacts can become verifier input.
profiles.repairHint: Run bun .archon/scripts/validate-agentic-search-capabilities.ts and inspect file-search evidence refs.

profiles.trustBoundary: Installed skill text can guide prompts and BMAD routing; it does not prove Archon provider nodes loaded skills at runtime.
profiles.repairHint: Refresh Context7 skills and rerun the Agentic Search validator.

profiles.trustBoundary: Database evidence is runtime authority only when captured by a current workflow artifact.
profiles.repairHint: Add a captured workflow artifact before treating database output as evidence.

profiles.trustBoundary: Remote web output is advisory unless captured locally with source, timestamp, and workflow evidence.
profiles.repairHint: Capture remote research into a declared evidence file before depending on it.

profiles.trustBoundary: Memory guides likely routes and prior decisions but may be stale; current repo evidence wins.
profiles.repairHint: Verify memory-derived claims against current files before promoting them into evidence.

profiles.trustBoundary: Shell output is authoritative only for the exact command and captured artifact from the current run.
profiles.repairHint: Run deterministic checks and store relevant output in workflow artifacts.

profiles.trustBoundary: Capability Lab summarizes and probes declared registries; it does not install MCPs, authorize tools, or approve Forge output.
Context7 docs and skills are advisory unless captured as local evidence; live MCP calls require auth and artifacts.
profiles.repairHint: Set CONTEXT7_API_KEY and capture workflow output before claiming live Context7 MCP support.

profiles.trustBoundary: UI-lab search metadata is advisory; shadcn registry, Storybook, and Playwright evidence remain UI readiness authority.
profiles.repairHint: Run bun run check:ui-lab and regenerate UI-lab Forge evidence when UI metadata changes.

profiles.trustBoundary: Route packets choose BMAD lanes and preserve MCP mentions as advisory context; they do not prove live runtime support.
profiles.repairHint: Run bun run cli validate workflows bmad-route-first and inspect route evidence.

profiles.trustBoundary: Forge consumes catalog, registry, and evidence only; it must not inspect source internals or call live tools.
profiles.repairHint: Run Forge only as a draft step and review generated artifacts before promotion.

profiles.trustBoundary: MCP names remain route context unless install, authorization, runtime call, and captured output prove live support; Codex per-node mcp/skills/agents/hooks remain unsupported.
profiles.repairHint: Keep requested MCP names in mcpAwareness and require runtime artifacts before making live claims.
